name: ember
description: Measures how warm the prompt cache stays across your idle gaps, and refreshes it before it expires.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Cache TTL in minutes, 1 to 1440, used when no FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl or ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H sets it. Set it to your plan default.

refresh.title: Refresh the cache before it expires
refresh.description: While you are idle, re-read the cached conversation shortly before the TTL ends, so that your next message finds the cache warm. Each refresh costs a cache read. Stops for a pause once the refreshes cost as much as one cold rewrite.

refreshShortTtl.title: Also refresh when the TTL is 5 minutes or less
refreshShortTtl.description: On by default. Set it to false to opt out at a 5-minute TTL. At a short TTL each refresh buys only a few minutes, so run /ember-refresh to check whether it pays on your pauses.

refreshLeadSeconds.title: Refresh lead (seconds before expiry)
refreshLeadSeconds.description: How long before the computed expiry a refresh runs, 10 to 3600. 0 picks the automatic lead: min(5 min, TTL / 5), so 5 min for a 60 min TTL and 1 min for a 5 min TTL. A lead that leaves under 10 s of TTL falls back to the automatic one.
